name: cray_electric_tap
description: A row of N CRAY(ELEC) cells on an FRME rail with a PSCN activation tap -- the community's recurring abstraction for 'this subsystem outputs power'.
why: Four independent fusion/containment saves in the 2026-08-25 harvest use CRAY(ctype=ELEC) the same way: 1732752's twin-CRAY(ELEC) feeder at (230-231,99-100)/(411-412,100), 2317325's 8-cell row at (117-124,187) sitting directly on its FRME coil structure, 2730526's 8-cell row at (110-124,201), and 2054452's 3-cell row at (119-135,298) on the antimatter containment's power draw. None of the existing 30 modules model a generator/output tap; this makes the emergent convention reusable.
source: save 2317325, CRAY row x117-124 y187 (8 cells, ctype=ELEC tmp=0) sitting on FRME (132 particles in the sampled box) with a PSCN tap (5 particles) nearby
